subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin was not wrong about the stone, and his frustration was legitimate.
source_quote: He wasn't wrong about the stone. And his frustration was legitimate — he'd made a reasonable preparation for a reasonable environment, and we'd somehow ended up standing in the one terrain where it didn't apply.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wanted to fireball the trees.
source_quote: Thorin's suggestion was to fireball the trees.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz considered the suggestion to fireball the trees briefly.
source_quote: I considered this briefly, which is about as much time as it deserves.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was already thinking past the suggestion to fireball the trees.
source_quote: Daz was already thinking past it. I could see it in the way he'd gone still — not my kind of still, but a wizard's still, the kind where the mind is moving very fast and the body has just stopped participating.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said he wanted to get some intel out of this.
source_quote: "I want to get some intel out of this," he said, the way a man says a thing when he's already decided what he's going to do.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz announced he was going to misty step up into the tree.
source_quote: "I'm going to misty step up into the tree," Daz announced.

subject: Someone's speculation about Jimjar
fact: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground, and I did not rule it out.
source_quote: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground. I did not rule it out.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum heard a bird call that was not a real bird — a cardinal's whistle, clean and bright, floating through tree cover that hadn't seen a cardinal in decades.
source_quote: The bird call came just as I was settling in for the night. Not a real bird — that was the point. A cardinal's whistle, clean and bright, floating through tree cover that hadn't seen a cardinal in decades, maybe ever.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the bird call was a successful imitation.
source_quote: Daz had been practicing. We all had, in the abstract, the way you talk about a plan more than you drill it. But hearing it land in the quiet of a forest evening, unmistakable against the rustle of leaves, I thought: *good. That actually worked.*

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool made an impression of a bird that was unrecognizable and entirely untrained.
source_quote: What followed it was Glabbagool, doing his best. His impression of a bird was everything you'd expect from a creature that has never encountered a bird, never encountered the concept of sound being produced intentionally for communication purposes, and was working from approximately zero reference points.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool was very proud of his bird impression.
source_quote: He was very proud of it.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool asked if the bird was a kind of ooze.
source_quote: "Is it a kind of ooze?" he asked, in that way he has, earnest and completely serious about the question.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum told Glabbagool that birds are feathered, not oozy.
source_quote: "No, no," I said, "they're not oozy at all. They're feathered."

subject: Glabbagool's understanding of feathers
fact: Glabbagool struggled to reconcile the concept of feathers with his understanding of creatures, and had no time to resolve it.
source_quote: The concept try to find somewhere to settle and fail to locate purchase. He didn't have three days. He had the next thirty seconds before we needed to move.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum said he would introduce Glabbagool to real birds.
source_quote: "We'll introduce you," I said. "Yeah, yeah, I wander over there."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the divine plan had them covered, provisionally.
source_quote: The divine plan has us covered, in the broadest possible sense — or at least I choose to believe it does, provisionally, and correct the belief when the evidence demands it.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum noticed the drow's movement from the north — careful, not panicked, close, twenty to forty feet.
source_quote: Thorin had picked up something in the terrain earlier — movement from the north, not panicked, not aggressive, careful. Close. Twenty, maybe forty feet.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum filed a mental note: drow on the surface, daylight hours, following quietly instead of attacking.
source_quote: The note I'd already filed, in my head: *drow, on the surface, daylight hours, following us quietly instead of attacking.*

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believed the drow was not a predator but a professional doing a job she'd rather not be doing.
source_quote: That combination doesn't say assassin to me. It says someone who got handed a bad assignment and is making the best of it. There's a difference between a predator and someone doing a job they'd rather not be doing, and I've learned to read that difference fast.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir ended the question of whether there would be a fight — there would not.
source_quote: By the time Glabbagool and I cleared the last of the underbrush, Zalthir had already ended the question of whether there would be a fight. There would not.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir grappled and stunned the drow spy with efficient finality.
source_quote: The spy — drow, slight, female, exactly as advertised — was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked who number two works for, in a voice with no subtlety.
source_quote: Thorin was standing over her, asking who number two works for, voice carrying through the trees with all the subtlety of a dwarf who was raised by hill giants and sees no reason to modulate volume as a social strategy.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said it was very rude to follow people without talking to them.
source_quote: "It's very rude," he said, which is the most Daz thing I've heard him say, possibly ever, "to follow people without just coming up and talking to them. So we'll talk to you now."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was calm and medical in his demeanor while tying up the drow.
source_quote: He said it while tying her up. The calm was so complete it was almost medical.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the drow was not watching the party but watching him, and working hard to hide it.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asked why he was so important that she was trying hard not to make it look like she was following him.
source_quote: "So we may be able to figure something out where you live, but first you need to answer some questions. Why am I so important that you're trying hard not to make it look like you're following me, but you're following me?"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz admitted he had been away from home for a while, correcting his earlier statement about being drow.
source_quote: "Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz learned the matron mother of House T'sarran had ruled for two hundred years.
source_quote: She told us her matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz realized the drow were using him as bait to find the person who paid to have him protected.
source_quote: "My matron believes that the one who paid —" and here she pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection — "for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz concluded the drow were watching to report back what happened to him, so they could trace the person who paid for his protection.
source_quote: "So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked the drow if she was looking for a new job.
source_quote: "Hey," he said, with the casual tone of someone considering a minor administrative matter, "are you looking for a new job? We could use another helper."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum handed the drow prayer beads without explanation or threat.
source_quote: Then Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on. No threat in his voice. No explanation of what they did.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum rolled persuasion and the drow talked.
source_quote: Then Grygum rolled persuasion, and she talked.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz learned the drow were sent to find where the party surfaced because their matron was waiting for them to surface.
source_quote: "I was just assigned to track you, not to engage. My orders were to report your surface destination, your contact, who approaches you."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz learned the drow's matron was looking for the person who paid to have him protected.
source_quote: "We are looking for that person, not for you."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz learned the matron cared because she cared — and therefore the drow cared.
source_quote: "The matron mother cares, and therefore I care."
